mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts below 2000 thousand units and retail sales below 340000 million dollars signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 340000 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has fallen below 2000 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.0% and decline in industrial production below 115.0 indicates stagflationary pressures that increase inflation expectations and reduce corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0 and INDPRO < 115.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for two consecutive months), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause S&P 500 underperformance, producing negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
